title: VVU Maturity Gates
description: Regulatory and technical prerequisites that must be met before each release milestone.

M0_Internal.label: Internal ready
M0_Internal.definition: All critical-path legal and regulatory prerequisites confirmed before any commercial member onboarding.

M1_Limited.label: Limited pilot
M1_Limited.definition: Closed pilot with nominated trustees. Externally approved governance and compliance artefacts.

M2_Public.label: Public production
M2_Public.definition: General availability for members. No further gating required.

legal_notes: M0_Internal is the legal handoff gate. Until M0_Internal is signed off, commercial onboarding is not permitted under FAIS Act s7 and POPIA.
